definitions.explanation: A visual representation of an area.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}を{見|み}て{道|みち}を{探|さが}す。
examples.english: To look for a road by looking at a map.

examples.japanese: スマホで{地図|ちず}アプリを{使|つか}う。
examples.english: To use a map app on a smartphone.

examples.japanese: この{地図|ちず}は{古|ふる}いから、{新|あたら}しいのを{買|か}おう。
examples.english: This map is old, so let's buy a new one.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}で{地図|ちず}をもらって、{歩|ある}いて{行|い}きたい{場所|ばしょ}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I got a map at the station and looked up the place I wanted to walk to.

notes:
{地図|ちず} means 'map'—a visual representation of an area showing locations, roads, and geographical features.

WORD FORMATION:
- {地|ち} (earth, ground) + {図|ず} (diagram, drawing) = map

TYPES OF MAPS:
- {世界|せかい}{地図|ちず}: world map
- {日本|にほん}{地図|ちず}: map of Japan
- {道路|どうろ}{地図|ちず}: road map
- {観光|かんこう}{地図|ちず}: tourist map
- {地下鉄|ちかてつ}{路線図|ろせんず}: subway map
- {地図|ちず}アプリ: map app (Google Maps, etc.)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {地図|ちず}を{見|み}る: to look at a map
- {地図|ちず}を{広|ひろ}げる: to spread out/open a map
- {地図|ちず}で{調|しら}べる: to check on a map
- {地図|ちず}に{載|の}っている: to be on the map

RELATED WORDS:
- {案内図|あんないず}: guide map, directory map
- {路線図|ろせんず}: route map (trains, buses)
- {白地図|はくちず}: blank map (for studying)
- GPS / ナビ: navigation system
